title: Pure Constellar
summary: The page's Glorious Gallery deckbuilding guide: Constellar and tellarknight cards (the new cards treat the two as one family), Stellarnova Bonds and generic staples. Constellar Castor, the one-card starter, summons another Constellar from the Deck; Tellarknight Cygnian searches, raises two Levels and counts as two materials. Delteros searches and gives an extra Normal Summon, and Constellar Tellarknights stacks a different-Rank Xyz on top, up to Exstellarknight Constellar Ptolemy Ω7, which can only use that shortcut in Main Phase 2. Castor and Stellarnova Bonds lock the Extra Deck to LIGHT/DARK or Xyz for the turn.
